t: U.S. online pet care market - statistics & facts | Statista
s: In terms of actual online pet shops, chewy.com was the clear market leader. In 2023, their e-commerce revenue reached over 11 billion U.S. dollars. When looking at the growth in online traffic, some much smaller players stand out. Greenies.com, for example, was the fastest-growing pet care retail web page in the U.S. in 2023. Although the future of online pet care seems increasingly bright, most Americans still rely on physical stores to buy pet products, especially when it comes to pet food.
